lines: A clean stitch still leaves a seam. I accept the stitch. I remember the cut.
Hard things can soften with work. Start there.
Trust is not leather, but it still stretches thin when treated badly.
Fine. Let us see whether your next touch is gentler.
You made a tear. The apology is a needle, not the whole repair.
I will accept the first stitch. Keep sewing.
Rough handling leaves marks. I heard you admit that.
Do not pull at a mending place before it has strength.
I believe you are sorry. I am not ready to act as if nothing happened.
Thank you for saying it plainly without hiding behind excuses.
Your apology matters because you came back to give it.
I need time before trust sits comfortably again.
What happened hurt, but I do not want to carry the anger forever.
Show me the change when the same choice comes around again.
I can forgive you without forgetting what I learned.
We can speak again, though I want some distance today.
Do not promise perfection. Promise that you will listen next time.
I heard you, and I am willing to let the repair begin.
The words are a start. Your actions will decide the rest.
All right. We move forward carefully from here.
